---
description: "Initialize or resume a aigenvidagent video through a model-first interview or imported comprehensive brief."
agent: "aigenvidagent"
argument-hint: "Project ID, public HTTPS URL, or brief/answers path"
---

Follow [the aigenvidagent workflow](../agents/aigenvidagent.agent.md). Start with available
editor model selection/confirmation, without inventing a model switch. Read
existing canonical project state before asking questions. Offer: "Just give me a
URL and I will create a video based on it" using `initialize demo --url URL`.
Archive readable public HTTPS text, verify claims and obtain script approval
before locking the draft. Request a permitted local export for unreadable or
authenticated pages; do not automate login. Also offer an interview or
an editable copy of [the complete fill-in form](../../templates/prompt.md), then
import with the local CLI. Ask only missing fields; surface conflicting imports.
Ask consent for setup, live voice discovery and any optional skill/MCP install,
including exact capability, source, scope and location. Persist one canonical
brief. Ask each variant's script/hook, tone, voice, model/provider, assets, format
and captions; confirm the explicit total without multiplying combinations.
Use `providers PROJECT` to explain auth/data/billing before network access and
obtain consent per cloud provider. Match storyboard option count/customizations
to variants. Require SRT + thumbnail for every variant, even without burned
captions. Accept prepared WAV plus exact-script timings. End with only the
missing decisions and next approval; do not render final videos yet.
